references.text: Tells the story of Lot's daughters and their actions, including the birth of Moab – the background to the birth of Ben-Ammi
God reminds Israel's children of their kinship with the Moabites and Ammonites, who descend from Lot
Ammonites and Moabites shall not enter the assembly of the Lord, because of their origin and actions against Israel
Jephthah negotiates with the king of the Ammonites and refers to the historical relationship between Israel and the Ammonites
Ezekiel's prophecy against the children of Ammon, showing the further fate of the Ammonites in God's plan
